Google跟進OpenAI、Anthropic，Gemini開始支援Mac電腦操作
items.summary: Google周四（11/19）宣布，旗下AI助理Gemini新增Mac電腦操作功能，可直接操作Mac上的應用程式、檔案及網站，替使用者完成多步驟工作，跟進OpenAI及Anthropic等業者在電腦操作型AI代理人領域的布局。

items.title: VMware發布資安更新，修補重大等級的vCenter漏洞，警告只能升級沒有其他替代緩解方法
items.summary: 11月19日博通（Broadcom）發布公告，修補VMware vCenter、VMware Tools，以及SDDC Manager當中5個漏洞，涵蓋身分驗證繞過、SQL注入、命令注入、權限提升，以及SAML權杖簽章繞過等弱點。其中，評為重大等級的vCenter身分驗證繞過漏洞CVE-2026-123890最為危險，由於除了套用更新之外沒有其他替代緩解措施，用戶應儘速採取行動因應。

items.title: 歐盟執委會遭AI網攻，ARTEX開源工具成駭客利器
items.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission）週四（11/19）對外證實，該機構10月22日偵測到使用AI工具的網路攻擊，至今已近一個月，部分內部系統仍無法使用，員工個資是否外洩也尚待釐清。 根據Politico週四率先揭露的消息，這起攻擊影響歐盟執委會多項內部系統，包括處理薪資、請假及工時紀錄的人力資源平臺Sysper、醫療費用報銷系統MyPMO，以及內部翻譯服務，且駭客使用了開源AI滲透測試框架ARTEX。

items.title: 全球首家前沿AI公司Anthropic上市，首日上漲17%
items.summary: Claude開發商Anthropic周四（11/19）正式在美國那斯達克（Nasdaq）掛牌，成為全球首家上市的前沿AI公司。Anthropic的股票代號為ANT，發行價為每股83美元，開盤即衝上111.5美元，最後以97.17美元作收，上漲17%，市值約1.27兆美元。 此次Anthropic IPO總計發售9.8億股，每股83美元，發售規模約813億美元，創下全球首次公開發行股票（IPO）規模紀錄。

items.title: fix(agents): run plugin session forks on the turn's real model (#202308)
items.summary: fix(agents): run plugin session forks on the turn's real model (#202308) A plugin fork (Skill Workshop review, Advisor) runs on the model of the turn it reads through. That lookup took the last assistant message's provider and model without skipping OpenClaw-authored rows, so a turn ending on a delivery mirror sent the fork to openclaw/delivery-mirror and it failed with "Unknown model". Skip transcript artifact rows there, as the other transcript model readers already do, so the fork uses the turn's last provider response or the session's selected model. Co-authored-by: Vincent Koc

items.title: fix(msteams): streamed reply is sent again when Teams rejects the for…
items.summary: fix(msteams): streamed reply is sent again when Teams rejects the formatted final (#158429) Root cause: `extensions/msteams/src/reply-stream-controller.ts:329` (current main) streams the raw Markdown progress final. Later, `finalize()` at `:396-401` clears the SDK buffer and emits the formatted text: tables become code blocks and headings become bold. That replaces content Teams already accepted, and Teams rejects it with 403 `Request streamed content should contain the previously streamed content`. The same block sets `replacementTextAwaitingAcknowledgement` (`:400`), so the late acknowledgement of the raw chunk is ignored (`:95-98`). The controller then believes nothing was delivered and returns the full answer as `fallbackPayload`, which goes out as a second message. Fixes #158103 ## What Problem This Solves With `streaming.mode: "progress"` in a Teams 1:1 chat, a multi-tool answer whose Markdown is reformatted for Teams (for example a table) fails to finalize. Teams reports `Request streamed content should contain the previously streamed content`, and the answer is sent again as a fallback. Teams documents that each streaming request "represents a full message update" and that "Requests that attempt to change content provided in previous request will result in a 403 ContentStreamNotAllowed error" ([Stream bot messages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/platform/bots/streaming-ux)). ## Why This Change Was Made The progress final is rendered before its first emission, through the existing `queueFinalReplacement` owner. The stream update and the close then carry the same rendered activity. Acknowledgements keep the logical Markdown for fallback accounting. Partial mode is unchanged. The root-cause repair is by @rdbartram (commit author kept), adapted by @ericcaiwx-star. Thanks to @rdbartram for the report and the sanitized live sequence. On top of it: a merge of current main, and the added tests folded into one controller regression. ## User Impact Progress-mode replies are streamed once in their Teams-formatted form and close cleanly: no 403, no duplicate answer. Plain-text answers and partial mode keep their current wire behavior. ## Evidence [Gateway proof comment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158429#issuecomment-7033619234), against base `477b611174`: - Base: raw table streamed (201), then 403 `Request streamed content should contain the previously streamed content` on the formatted update and on the final message. The stream is never closed. The controller returns the full answer as fallback because it ignored the raw acknowledgement (diagnostic probe). On current main, that fallback is then dropped by a separate `MSTeams runtime not initialized` error in the late settlement path. The reporter's 2026.9.6 build delivered it as the duplicate. - Candidate `14cc468efa`: rendered table streamed once (201), final message 201, one answer. - Controls are identical on base and candidate: a plain-text progress answer and a partial-mode table. - Unit: the new controller case fails on base and passes on the candidate. The controller, SDK loopback and dispatcher suites pass (59 tests). Merge danger: two-way door. The change only alters what one msteams progress-mode stream emits and can be reverted cleanly; it writes no state and changes no config. Blast radius: Microsoft Teams personal chats using progress streaming. Co-authored-by: Ryan Bartram Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(sandbox): keep NuGet and Convex caches out of workspace results (…
items.summary: fix(sandbox): keep NuGet and Convex caches out of workspace results (#202327) Cloud workspace reconciliation and idle cleanup could reject an entire result because NuGet HTTP caches or Convex backend binaries exceeded the per-file result limit. These re-downloadable files were missing from the shared derived workspace path policy and were consequently treated as user output. Exclude the exact NuGet http-cache and documented v3-cache roots, NuGet global packages, and Convex binaries. NuGet roots provide their documented relocation settings through the existing recovery guidance. Regenerate both manifest consumers and update the excluded-cache documentation. Preserve neighboring user files, nested fixtures, staged inputs, and the result size limit. Evidence: the extended existing cache table fails on base b9d3c00e4f91 (2 failed, 9 passed) and passes on this head. Focused capture, transfer, manifest and node-worker suites pass 44 tests across four files. Core and targeted test types, lint, formatting, generated assets, and diff checks pass. Codex autoreview is scoped-clean through P2; coordinator review approved the unchanged diff. The test change adds 9 and removes 10 lines, net -1. Required CI run 44694390840 is green for c46979ac111d. The repository watcher reported GREEN with zero pending checks after accounting for 16 superseded contexts. The three cancelled Auto response jobs explicitly report a higher priority waiting request in the same PR concurrency group. No CI rerun was used.
